source_precedence: Use each source only for its revision and purpose. Later explicit corrections supersede earlier analyses. Quotes and product requirements do not prove as-built hardware.
repository_verification: For SUDO_REPO entries, SHA-256 values and line references use the listed git_revision. Verify original bytes in the ShopItalic/app checkout with git show <git_revision>:<path>, not this firmware repository or the app working-tree contents.
scope: Read-only extraction. No live ring teardown/readback, factory release, purchase, shipment, or certification verified.

virtual_roots.KIT: Commercial kit including ring companion case and packaging
virtual_roots.HISTORICAL: Earlier options excluded from the current baseline

bom_conventions.quantity: Blank means unspecified. Singular component quantities are inferred unless the quantity_basis says otherwise. Integrated parts are included in their parent.
bom_conventions.alternatives: BAT10, BAT11 and BAT12 are mutually exclusive size variants under R09. Historical items are excluded from current totals.
bom_conventions.costs: Component CSV and commercial cost CSV are different views. Do not sum fitted-component breakdowns in addition to their quoted PCBA or assembly parent.
